prompts: Wide low-angle shot, slightly looking up, of a fog-filled street in a near-future endless city at dusk. A man stands in the foreground: square face, short buzz cut, prominent brow ridge, a thin scar on his left eyebrow, lean build, wearing a dark blue waterproof jacket with a reflective strip on the left chest, a black square delivery bag with worn straps on his back, and a black half-finger glove on his right hand. Behind him, a tall apartment building with a metal number plate reading '37' suddenly slides sideways away from the street, the plate vanishing first. The man freezes, shoulders stiffening, head turning slightly as he stares at the empty space. Cold blue-grey fog, high-contrast cinematic lighting, landscape 832x480.

A medium shot, handheld camera tracking a running man from behind at a slight angle in a fog-heavy street of an endless near-future city. The man, Asu, has a square face, short buzz cut, prominent brow ridge with a thin scar on his left eyebrow, lean build; he wears a dark blue waterproof jacket with a reflective strip on the left chest, black cargo pants, black high-top boots, a black square delivery bag with worn straps on his back, and a black half-finger glove on his right hand. He sprints forward, then abruptly stops, chest heaving heavily, and raises his right wrist to open a delivery terminal. Thick fog drifts, cold blue-grey light, high contrast, cinematic. The camera shakes slightly with his motion and settles as he checks the device.

A close-up over-the-shoulder shot of a young delivery man, Asu, in a foggy, endless near-future city street corner. He has a square face, short buzz cut, prominent brow ridge, a thin scar on his left eyebrow, and a lean build. He wears a dark blue waterproof jacket with a reflective strip on the left chest, black cargo pants, black high-top boots, a black half-finger glove on his right hand, and carries a black square delivery bag with worn straps. He leans against a concrete wall, shaking his head firmly in refusal while tightening his grip on the bag. Cool-toned, high-contrast lighting with mist diffusing the streetlights. Fixed camera, over-the-shoulder angle, landscape 832x480.

In a misty, near-future endless city alley under constant dim daylight, a lean young man with a square face, short buzz cut, prominent brow ridge and a thin scar on his left eyebrow, wearing a dark blue waterproof jacket with a reflective strip on the left chest, black cargo pants, black high-top boots, a black half-finger glove on his right hand, and a black square delivery bag with worn straps on his back, runs urgently through the alley. The alley walls on both sides shift and slide sideways, grinding and rearranging. He dodges left and right, sprinting toward the camera as it tracks sideways with him in a full shot, wide angle. Cold, high-contrast lighting, foggy air, dust and small debris falling. 832x480 landscape.

Close-up, low-angle shot of a young male courier, A-su, in a foggy, perpetually overcast near-future city street. He has a square face, short buzz cut, prominent brow ridge, a thin scar on his left eyebrow, lean build, wearing a dark blue waterproof jacket with a reflective strip on the left chest, black cargo pants, black high-top boots, black fingerless gloves on his right hand, and a black square delivery bag with worn straps. He rushes toward a door and reaches out his right gloved hand to touch the door handle. The camera slowly pushes in from his hand toward the door handle. The building suddenly vanishes with a humming sound, leaving only empty space. A package address label on his bag automatically updates with a printing sound. Cool tones, high contrast lighting, cinematic.
